rules.activation: Roster active is ignored; DNP and missing roster entries do not establish inactive status
rules.ambiguous: didNotPlay=false with valid=false is unresolved, even when stats exist
rules.availability: Completed game, matching kickoff, and evidence retrieved after kickoff plus 24 hours
rules.claims: Compare enrollment-time starter annotations with retrospective flags; outcome agreement is not source-content adjudication
rules.conflict: Roster DNP with a QB stats target remains a conflict, including zero-yard targets
rules.denominator: The existing registry's complete candidate pool; enrollment is never replaced
rules.dnp: Explicit didNotPlay=true, starter=false, valid=false plus no recorded QB appearance
rules.forecast: No model execution, probabilities, EV, calibration validation or production enablement
rules.identity: Unique ESPN-to-GSIS QB mapping must agree with the original candidate IDs
rules.played: Period-zero valid roster entry with didNotPlay=false plus a recorded QB stats target
